patch_description: Adopt the proven elastic thresholding mechanism from Seed 3 to increase trade frequency while maintaining signal quality. Add conviction-scaled position sizing and volatility-elastic exits. These changes directly address why the current program trades 62 fewer times (468 vs 530) while maintaining win rate. The elastic multiplier (0.88 + 0.18 * vol_impulse) allows the model to capture more high-probability moves during volatile regimes while being more conservative in low-volatility noise. Conviction scaling ensures we size larger for stronger signals. Volatility-elastic exits prevent over-holding in declining volatility regimes.
